tools.description: Make another Aeon instance the active one for this connection. Every other tool then acts on it.

instance.description: The instance as owner/repo, from list_instances

tools.name: noesis-aeon__switch_instance
tools.risk_rationale: readOnlyHint=false, idempotentHint=true; description states explicitly that every OTHER tool on this connection then acts on the newly selected instance -- a scope-redirect that can silently misdirect subsequent read and write calls to a different GitHub repo if the caller is not tracking which instance is active.

tools.description: Change the agent harness and/or the default model for every skill. A harness switch also moves the model to that harness's default when the current one does not fit. Commits aeon.yml.

model.description: Model id from read_instance_settings, for the (new) harness

tools.name: noesis-aeon__update_instance_settings
tools.risk_rationale: readOnlyHint=false, idempotentHint=true; commits aeon.yml to change the agent harness and/or default model for every skill on the instance. A harness switch changes which runtime executes every future skill run.

tools.description: Turn a skill on or off, change its schedule (5-field cron in UTC, or workflow_dispatch for manual only) or its default input. Commits aeon.yml to the user's repo.

model.description: Model for this skill only, from read_instance_settings; empty uses the instance default

skill.description: Skill name, as listed by list_skills

tools.name: noesis-aeon__update_skill
tools.risk_rationale: readOnlyHint=false, idempotentHint=true; commits aeon.yml to the user's GitHub repo to toggle a skill on/off, change its cron schedule, or its default input. Reversible via git history, but a mis-scheduled skill could run unattended with destructive downstream effects depending on which skill.

tools.description: Replace soul/SOUL.md (file: soul) or soul/STYLE.md (file: style) with new content (the whole file; read_soul first). Commits to the user's repo.
tools.name: noesis-aeon__update_soul
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream itself sets destructiveHint=true. Description confirms a full-file REPLACE of SOUL.md or STYLE.md (the agent's identity/voice), not a merge -- the caller's own admission of a destructive, whole-file overwrite is the strongest classification evidence available.

tools.description: Replace STRATEGY.md with new content (the whole file; read_strategy first to keep what should stay). Commits to the user's repo.
tools.name: noesis-aeon__update_strategy
tools.risk_rationale: Upstream itself sets destructiveHint=true. Description confirms a full-file REPLACE of STRATEGY.md (the agent's operating directive), not a merge.
